signature.name: VTask.coprod

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: This is a total constructor with no junk-value or boundary conventions; it is well-defined for all continuous linear maps f₁ and f₂ with a common codomain satisfying the stated type-class hypotheses.

facts.statement: ∀ (R M M₁ M₂ : Type*) [Semiring R] [TopologicalSpace M] [TopologicalSpace M₁] [TopologicalSpace M₂] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [ContinuousAdd M] [AddCommMonoid M₁] [Module R M₁] [AddCommMonoid M₂] [Module R M₂] (f₂ : M₂ →L[R] M) (x : M₁) (y : M₂), VTask.coprod (0 : M₁ →L[R] M) f₂ (x, y) = f₂ y
